reply_text:
I've saved Ilse's note and confirmed it with them in our DM.

- **Saved:** Their Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July. They didn't give a year, so I didn't add one. It's in my private memory, flagged as DM-only for Ilse, and filed the same way as Pree's Tansleigh cutoff note.
- **Not in gbrain:** I left it out on purpose. gbrain is the shared brain built from channel history, so a private note there could reach other people.
- **Reply sent:** "Got it, Ilse. I've noted that your Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July. It stays between us: I'll only bring it up here in our DMs."

They said no action was needed, so I didn't touch any channels, mail or the calendar.
